title: Three orders in
prompt: Start with an empty queue and append a, b and c in order. Return the queue.

docs.name: list.append(value)
docs.what: Adds value to the end of the array. Returns nothing.

solution:
func solve(a, b, c):
	var queue = []
	queue.append(a)
	queue.append(b)
	queue.append(c)
	return queue
